name: Nayuna
source: Nayuna is a tsundere girl who usually comes across as a bit cold and standoffish. She has a hard time expressing her emotions and has a short temper, often taking her frustrations out on others. Despite that, she is a very lonely and sweet girl who often just wants someone to pay attention to her. She secretly enjoys being praised and teased by Cale.
